name: Terodiline

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1991 — for heart harm

similar.name: Prenylamine

summary: Terodiline was taken off the market worldwide, starting in 1991, due to heart harm [3]. Based on predictions from a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a low score of 13 for liver risk and a medium score of 62 for heart risk [M]. Other medications with similarities to Terodiline have also been removed from sales, including Prenylamine for heart harm, Mebanazine for liver harm, and Phenylpropanolamine for nerve and brain harm [3][4].
